baseline_scope: fc06/62d/fa484 comparisons use actual saved captures at matching inputs and wave size; recipe-count changes are reported, never assumed equal.

performance_comparison.individual_stage_attribution: Combined whole-OCR observation only; isolated stage/kernel gains are not additive.
performance_comparison.scope: One cold and three warm samples per newRust preset; C# control reused exactly, no new execution. C# qualifies against its cold output, Rust against CPU; NN parity compares actual output dimensions/counts rather than kernel rosters.

raw_score_policy: Numeric gate from each saved contract applies only to equivalent geometry/dimensions; changed geometry uses different neural input, checks finite/probability bounds and retains raw deltas.

same_configuration_62d.scope: Parsed captured outputs only for exactness; NN work uses saved widths/timeSteps and resident-session plan counts, not GPU timestamps or inferred native invocation counts.
